## Why This Is Asked
Tests a practical, beginner-friendly approach to deduplication that touches HTTP, DB, and Kafka, a common source of subtle bugs in CNPA stacks.

- Idempotency keys
- DB unique constraints
- Kafka at-least-once vs exactly-once
- Testing retries, race conditions

```sql
CREATE TABLE users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE
);
```

```sql
INSERT INTO users (id, name, idempotency_key) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
```

- How to handle expired idempotency keys?
- What about distributed transactions across services?

```python
tracer = trace.get_tracer(__name__)

```
